title: YorvoGate scope status, format 1
description: The answer of GET /_yorvogate/v1/scopes/<name> on a trusted listener (docs/configuration.md#scope-status). With sha256 or absent, the request waited: matched tells whether what it waited for came. A 408 answer has matched false and the current state, which is never the state waited for: treat it as a failure.

generation.description: Snapshots of the scope files swapped in since the gate started: information only, not proof that a write is in it.

file_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the scope file the state is about, a refused one included. Absent when there is no file.

state.description: loaded: in effect (its socket open, on a listener with scope sockets). refused: its file isn't valid, or collides, and it holds no claims. reserved: refused, but its last valid claims are held for it. unknown: no scope file.
